variants.message: Hi Jordan -- I lead backend teams and have been working through the same ownership problems you wrote about at Acme Corp. Would love to hear how you're approaching it.

variants.subject: Quick question about on-call ownership
variants.message: Hi Jordan, I'm reaching out because we're building a tool that helps teams assign clear service ownership -- I noticed you wrote about this exact gap at Acme Corp. Would you be open to a 15-minute call to see if it'd be useful for your team? No pressure either way.
Hi Jordan -- a mutual interest in backend reliability brought me here. I'm looking to build out my network with people tackling ownership and on-call problems, and your recent writing stood out.
